command: set -u; echo '=== HOST ==='; date -Is; hostname; whoami; pwd; echo '=== SSH MATERIAL NAMES ONLY ==='; find ~/.ssh -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f %m %s\n' 2>/dev/null | sort || true; echo '=== VPS TCP ==='; timeout 5 bash -lc '</dev/tcp/72.61.19.188/22' && echo VPS_SSH_TCP=OPEN || echo VPS_SSH_TCP=FAIL; echo '=== VPS BATCH SSH ==='; for u in root clay ubuntu; do echo USER=$u; if timeout 8 ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new "$u@72.61.19.188" 'printf "VPS_SSH_OK host="; hostname; printf " uid="; id -u; printf "\n"' 2>&1; then break; fi; done; echo '=== GITHUB SSH ==='; timeout 8 ssh -T -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 git@github.com 2>&1 | head -10 || true; echo '=== END ==='
